claim: If you check the health of failover, geolocation, geoproximity, latency, multivalue or weighted records and specify the endpoint by domain name, specify the domain name of each server for Domain name, not the name of the records. If the Domain name of a health check matches the name of the records and you associate the health check with those records, health check results will be unpredictable.

evidence.quote: In this configuration, if you create a health check for which the value of **Domain name** matches the name of the records and then associate the health check with those records, health check results will be unpredictable.

If you want to check the health of failover, geolocation, geoproximity, latency, multivalue, or weighted records, and you choose to specify the endpoint by domain name, we recommend that you create a separate health check for each endpoint.
For the value of **Domain name**, specify the domain name of the server (such as us-east-2-www.example.com), not the name of the records (www.example.com).
